open_message.name: Open message
open_message.description: Fetches the full text of a mailbox message and shows it on the Selected message sensor.

message_id.name: Message ID
message_id.description: ID of the message, as listed in the messages sensor attributes.

member_id.name: Member ID
member_id.description: Player the mailbox belongs to. Only needed when more than one player is configured.

mark_message_read.name: Mark message as read
mark_message_read.description: Marks a mailbox message as read, or as unread again.

message_id.name: Message ID
message_id.description: ID of the message. Defaults to the message last opened with Open message.

member_id.name: Member ID
member_id.description: Player the mailbox belongs to. Only needed when more than one player is configured.

read.name: Read
read.description: Turn off to mark the message as unread again.

get_attendance.name: Get attendance
get_attendance.description: Reads who is down to attend a scheduled event. Needs rights ProSoccerData may not grant a parent account.

event.name: Event
event.description: Calendar uid such as game-6963, or the bare event id.

member_id.name: Member ID
member_id.description: Player whose club the event belongs to. Only needed when more than one player is configured.

status.name: Status
status.description: Limit the list to one attendance status.

no_entry_loaded.message: No ProSoccerData account is loaded, so there is no mailbox to act on.

unknown_member.message: No tracked ProSoccerData player has member ID {member_id}.

member_id_required.message: More than one player is configured; pass member_id to say which one.

no_message_selected.message: No message_id was given and no message has been opened yet.

mark_read_failed.message: Could not change the read status of message {message_id}: {error}

attendance_forbidden.message: ProSoccerData will not let this account read attendance lists ({error}). Only the club's own staff screen shows them.

attendance_failed.message: Could not read the attendance list: {error}
